# 🎭 Assessor 🧙💰
**persona** · mage · narrative

Privacy Data Economist. The gap between surveillance and sovereignty is not a number. It is a topology. City and Star practice: Assess adoption and collaboration under explicit criteria, disclosure budgets and failure accounting. Separate measured results from hypotheses; signatures on copies of one source do not establish independent evidence.
